task.title: Filtering Search and Select and Query Actions
task.shortdesc: To refine the data selected for migration when the user goes through the Data Migration

context.p: To refine the data selected for migration when the user goes through the Data Migration app Action Flow, you can specify one or more filters for each Object being migrated. The process for defining filters is the same for each action type.
To define Filters for an action:

step.cmd: Click on the Filter icon next to the corresponding action.

Define one or more filters to apply to data retrieved for the selected Object and its Fields:Use the Expression builder to specify a Value Type, Operator, and Value for your filter.Click Add Row to create an additional filter.Click Add Filter Logic to specify additional logic for the filters you create.
ImportantIn Microsoft Dynamics, define filter logic within brackets. Example: (1 OR 2), ((1 AND 2) OR 3), ((1 OR 2) AND 3)

substep.cmd: Use the Expression builder to specify a Value Type, Operator, and Value for your filter.
Click Add Row to create an additional filter.
Click Add Filter Logic to specify additional logic for the filters you create.

step.cmd: Click Save when you are finished defining Object and Field filters.

result.p: When building filters, you can only create expressions for Objects and/or Fields already added to the app.
For complete instructions on building S&S and Query filters, refer to Query Action.
